title: Add escalation playbook + SLA policy links to Support docs nav
author: Elliot Price
description: Context: As part of the Customer Success & Support escalation playbook refresh and known-issues sprint, Support asked that the internal docs site make the key references discoverable from the Support landing + left-nav (instead of buried in Confluence search). This PR updates navigation + cross-links to (1) Escalation Playbook (paths/contacts, severity matrix, bridge conventions, exec escalation), (2) SLA policy by customer tier, and (3) customer comms templates; it also adds a short “How to use these docs during an escalation” blurb and ensures link text matches the published Confluence titles. Scope: navigation + internal doc pages only; no customer-sensitive details, no new policy content (policy source of truth remains Confluence). Notes: Links use the existing internal Confluence link helper so they resolve correctly in preview/prod; link targets intentionally point at the canonical Confluence pages rather than duplicating content in the docs site. Follow-ups: INT-333 will add Jira automation to prompt linking the index; ENG-4826 will ship the public known-issues landing separately (PR 2841).

implementation_notes: Navigation: Adds a top-level “Escalations & SLAs” group under Support, adjacent to Triage/Intake. Adds a dedicated internal hub page to reduce link sprawl and to keep Confluence as the system of record. Copy: Uses consistent naming: Support Priority (P0–P4) and Incident Severity (Sev0–Sev3) and links to the mapping doc; includes a reminder that Support should not bypass #incidents criteria and should follow bridge conventions. Sensitivity: Explicit callout that the docs site should not include direct phone numbers, personal emails, or customer-identifying incident details; those stay in Confluence with appropriate permissions.
